title: snack update payload
description: The `data` of a `snack update --json` document. `applied` is false for `--dry-run`, where `plan` describes exactly what would run and nothing is installed; it is true once the plugin has been re-registered, where `registered_plugin` names the pin written, or is null when nothing was registered and so nothing was rewritten. A consumer must tolerate fields added by a later minor.

plan.description: The resolved package-manager invocation. Present on a dry run.

command.description: The invocation as a single line, for display and confirmation.

registered_plugin.description: The plugin specifier written into OpenCode's configuration, or null when nothing was registered.
